data.name: Rayyana
data.gender_notes: Rayyana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rayyana is an Arabic Islamic name for girls, which means luxurious, rich. This name is derived from the word 'Rayyan', which means 'well watered' or 'abundant', and is also the name of one of the gates of paradise. The name Rayyana carries the meaning “Luxurious, Rich” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Rayyana usually hope their child will grow to embody luxurious, rich and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name representing abundance, prosperity and blessings from Allah.
data.etymology: Rayyana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Luxurious, Rich.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rayyana total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
